meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 装上后,当用户问及 Codex Rules 时,Claude 会说明:规则引擎自动在会话开始和用户提交时注入静态项目说明,在 Codex 的 apply_patch 后注入匹配文件的具体规则;动态工具输出不会被改写。同时列出支持的规则文件位置和环境变量。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 的运作机制、规则匹配或环境配置等话题时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 是如何自动生效的?
say.note: 会解释会话开始与提交时的注入行为。

say.text: 它支持哪些规则文件位置?
say.note: 会列出 CONTEXT.md、.omo/rules 等位置。

say.text: 有哪些环境变量可以配置 Codex Rules?
say.note: 会列出 CODEX_RULES_* 等设置。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude explains Codex Rules behavior: automatic injection of static instructions at session start/user prompt, injection of matching file rules after apply_patch, no rewriting of tool output, plus supported rule sources and env knobs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: Which rule file locations are supported?
say_en.note: Lists sources such as CONTEXT.md and .omo/rules.

say_en.text: What env vars configure Codex Rules?
